name: BPURI
recent: Bina Puri 在截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日的季度录得净利 6758 万令吉，主要来自一次性收益；公司刚于 11 月 19 日举行第 34 届常年股东大会，所有议案均获通过。此外，公司宣布董事经理 Matthew Tee Kai Woon 辞去执行董事职务，并有一项备忘录及一项清盘/接管相关公告。
notable: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度净利 6758 万令吉，主要来自一次性收益。
第 34 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 19 日举行，所有议案获股东通过。
执行董事 Matthew Tee Kai Woon 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日辞任。
risks: 公司有一项清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理人的公告（2026 年 9 月 7 日）。
季度营收同比下滑 49.6%，环比下滑 10.3%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度营收 3159 万令吉，同比下滑 49.6%，环比下滑 10.3%；净利 6758 万令吉，净利率 213.9%，去年同期净利率为 -26.6%。

recent_en: Bina Puri reported a net profit of MYR67.58 million for the quarter ended 31 August 2026, mainly driven by one-off gains. The company held its 34th AGM on 19 November 2026, where all resolutions were passed. It also announced the resignation of Executive Director Matthew Tee Kai Woon, along with a memorandum of understanding and a winding-up/receivership-related announcement.
notable_en: Net profit of MYR67.58 million for the quarter ended 31 August 2026, mainly from one-off gains.
The 34th AGM was held on 19 November 2026, with all resolutions passed by shareholders.
Executive Director Matthew Tee Kai Woon resigned on 1 October 2026.
risks_en: The company made a winding-up/receivership/restraining order/special administrator announcement on 7 September 2026.
Quarterly revenue fell 49.6% year-on-year and 10.3% quarter-on-quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was MYR31.59 million, down 49.6% year-on-year and 10.3% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR67.58 million with a net margin of 213.9%, compared with a net margin of -26.6% a year earlier.
